At sampling you can also choose fold-over footies, envelope shoulders and snap-crotch openings.

Which safety rules apply to baby pieces sold in the US and the EU?

US baby pieces need the same CPSIA tests and [Children's Product Certificate](/kids-hawaiian-clothing-manufacturer/) as the rest of our kids' clothing, booked at the laboratory's rate. For the EU, cords and ties follow EN 14682, and on newborn to 24-month pieces we leave out detachable small parts.

How do you set care labels and pack baby pieces?

We wash-test your bulk fabric and print, then write the care label from those results, so the instructions match how each piece behaves in the wash. Every piece is folded and sealed in its own poly bag with your insert card, and our [Packaging](/packaging/) service adds barcodes or branded bags.
